# ASU Research Portal (Elsevier Pure)

> > Arizona State University's research information system showcasing faculty profiles, research publications, and institutional facilities across diverse disciplines.

This portal, powered by Elsevier Pure, provides comprehensive access to ASU's research ecosystem including faculty expertise, scholarly output, and specialized research facilities like the X-Ray Diffraction Facility and DNA Laboratory. The system integrates with Scopus to track research impact across the College of Liberal Arts and Sciences, Ira A. Fulton Schools of Engineering, and other major ASU academic units.

## Key Topics

- Arizona State University
- Elsevier Pure
- Scopus
- Faculty profiles
- Research publications
- College of Liberal Arts and Sciences (CLAS)
- Ira A. Fulton Schools of Engineering
- Sustainability Initiative
- X-Ray Diffraction Facility

- Materials characterization
- Crystallography

## Research Facilities & Equipment

- [CLAS: X-Ray Diffraction Facility](https://asu.elsevierpure.com/en/equipments/clas-x-ray-diffraction-facility): X-Ray Diffraction Facility with Bruker D8 for crystallography research
- [CLAS: DNA Laboratory](https://asu.elsevierpure.com/en/equipments/clas-dna-laboratory): CLAS DNA Lab: sequencing, fragment analysis & real-time PCR facility

## STEM & Engineering Faculty

- [Mark Holl](https://asu.elsevierpure.com/en/persons/mark-holl): Mark Holl researcher profile: microfluidics & biological physics
- [James Aberle](https://asu.elsevierpure.com/en/persons/james-aberle): James Aberle associate professor: antenna research & microstrip engineering
- [Gi-Yeul Bae](https://asu.elsevierpure.com/en/persons/gi-yeul-bae): Gi-Yeul Bae faculty: working memory, visual cognition & schizophrenia

## Social Sciences & Psychology Faculty

- [Shantel Meek](https://asu.elsevierpure.com/en/persons/shantel-meek): Shantel Meek faculty: child development, autism & early childhood education
- [Rachel Koffer](https://asu.elsevierpure.com/en/persons/rachel-koffer): Rachel Koffer faculty: aging psychology, loneliness & stress research
- [Rafael Martinez](https://asu.elsevierpure.com/en/persons/rafael-martinez): Rafael Martinez faculty: Latinx psychology, mental health & grief studies
- [Stella Rouse](https://asu.elsevierpure.com/en/persons/stella-rouse): Stella Rouse faculty: Latino politics & millennial generational studies
- [Rocio Garcia](https://asu.elsevierpure.com/en/persons/rocio-garcia): Rocio Garcia assistant professor: Latinx studies & feminist social justice

## Humanities & Arts Faculty

- [Patrick Bixby](https://asu.elsevierpure.com/en/persons/patrick-bixby): Patrick Bixby faculty profile: Irish modernism & Beckett studies
- [Neal Lester](https://asu.elsevierpure.com/en/persons/neal-lester): Neal Lester English professor: children's literature & literacy studies
- [Julie Anand](https://asu.elsevierpure.com/en/persons/julie-anand): Julie Anand faculty: sustainability, art & industrial landscape photography
- [Julia Sarreal](https://asu.elsevierpure.com/en/persons/julia-sarreal): Julia Sarreal faculty: Latin American history, Spanish empire & yerba mate
- [Maura Priest](https://asu.elsevierpure.com/en/persons/maura-priest): Maura Priest faculty: epistemology, virtue epistemology & collective beliefs

## Health Sciences & Religion Faculty
